title: Faraday's laws of electromagnetic induction
notes: **Scope.** Faraday's laws of electromagnetic induction — Electromagnetic Induction, Physics (class-12-notes).
**Tested.** define it · list: faraday's laws of electromagnetic induction · one worked example · one misconception each.
**Fact.** Force on moving charge F = q(v×B); on a wire F = BIL sinθ.
**Fact.** Faraday: EMF ε = −dΦ/dt; Lenz's law gives the sign (induced current opposes the change in flux).
**Fact.** Self-inductance L = NΦ/I; inductance stores energy U = ½LI². Mutual inductance M couples two coils.
